group.title: Engine fixes
group.text: Less work per frame. Nothing looks or sounds different.

group.title: Effects and map
group.text: Less to draw. These change how the game looks.

group.title: Physics
group.text: Less to simulate. Some things stop moving.

group.title: Visibility
group.text: Easier to read in a fight.

option.title: Sound stack update cap
option.text: Playing sounds update about 60 times a second instead of every frame.
option.how: By default, the engine recalculates spatial audio for every active sound on every frame (around 80 at once in a team fight). With this cap, each sound updates every 15-17 ms, roughly matching the 64 Hz server tick rate, on a staggered timer so updates spread across frames. New sounds still trigger immediately.

option.title: Particle Pruning
option.text: Effects keep their shapes and warnings, without the glow, smoke and sparks.
option.how: Abilities, items, explosions and pickups lose their glow, flashes, sparks and smoke; bosses only when idle or dying. The map loses its fog, steam, smoke and street light glow, movement raises no dust, and the decoration that stays draws half as many particles.
option.alt: A fight with the stock particles, then the same frame with Particle Pruning: no smoke, sparks or lightning, the ability ring still there

choice.title: Stock tracers and hit effects
choice.text: Default tracers, minus blood and impact debris on heroes.

choice.title: Reduced tracers and hit effects
choice.text: Fainter tracers. No bullet impacts, blood or headshot effects.

option.title: Low detail map
option.text: 414 textures and 676 materials swapped for low-detail versions.
option.how: Smaller textures need less VRAM and memory bandwidth, and simpler materials are cheaper to shade.
option.alt: Broadway street stock, then with Low detail map: plain road without painted markings, dark billboards and simpler materials

option.title: Brighter lighting
option.text: Brighter, flatter lighting with vignette, base bloom, and lamp/storm glow removed.
option.how: Vignette, local exposure, and bloom run full-screen passes every frame. A retuned tonemap keeps visibility bright, and smaller funnel clouds cut down transparent overdraw.
option.alt: Broadway street stock, then with Brighter lighting: brighter and flatter, no vignette, bloom or sky glow

option.title: Cloth simulation off
option.text: Coats, capes, skirts and dresses removed from the 17 heroes that have them.
option.warn: Not compatible with other mods that replace hero models.
option.how: Cloth simulates every frame. Disabling simulation alone freezes coats and capes in their rest pose, so they're removed from the models instead. Hair, tails, and straps remain static.
option.alt: All 17 heroes with cloth, from the side where it shows most, then without it

option.title: Ragdolls off
option.text: Heroes and troopers don't ragdoll when they die.
option.warn: Players caught in Doorman's ultimate sometimes fade.
option.how: Skips client-side ragdoll physics when heroes and troopers die.

option.title: jcStani's HP Bars
option.text: Performance-neutral hero health bars (blue for allies, yellow for enemies, HP number above enemy bars).
option.link_text: Make your own in the HP Bar Builder
option.how: A plain stylesheet with no scripts, so the game updates them like the stock bars.

pic.alt: Two heroes with flat health bars: an ally's blue bar, and an enemy's yellow bar with its health, 2,990, above it

option.title: Health tick lines off
option.text: For custom health bars without ticks (jcStani's HP Bars or HP Bar Builder).
option.warn: Also removes tick lines from stock health bars and HP Bar Builder styles that use them.
option.how: Custom health bars only hide tick lines visually; the engine still creates and lays out a panel for every health increment. Setting the increment to 1,000,000 prevents those panels from being created.
